name: Taiwan Bio Therapeutics Co., Ltd
summary: Taiwan Bio Therapeutics Co., Ltd. is an enterprise specializing in regenerative medicine, primarily dedicated to the development of novel cellular therapeutics. These advanced treatments are crafted to address a range of medical conditions, including degenerative disorders, cardiovascular ailments, complications stemming from diabetes, and autoimmune diseases. The company was established in 2014 and its operations are headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.
